name: claude-harness
description: A working Claude Code setup: review gate, retrospectives, reference-first design, goal trees and plain-language reports.

plugins.name: harness-skills
plugins.description: ready-review (review gate before a PR goes ready), session-retro (one-turn retrospective) and show-first (references before building a new look).

plugins.name: goal-tree
plugins.description: Before a big job, build the goal tree with the user: top goal, sub-goals, and ordered milestones you can check.

plugins.name: human-readable-reports
plugins.description: Make AI-written analysis and report docs easy for humans to read and share (fights AI verbosity and slop).

plugins.name: review-inbox
plugins.description: Your GitHub work in a drawer: PRs waiting for your review, your open PRs with their reviews, and your issues.
